baseline_models.mechanism: The two nominals divide reception into orientation and reactivation: guidance gently indicates a true route, while remembrance restores what absence or forgetfulness displaced. The pair supplies both an initial bearing and recurrent course correction.

activation_trace.role: Gentle indication toward a path or truth supplies the orienting half of the paired mechanism.
Restoring something after forgetfulness supplies recurrent recovery rather than a second synonym for guidance.
A reminder that makes something present again turns recovery into the maintenance phase of orientation.

changed_reading.before: Guidance and remembrance are two near-synonymous labels for beneficial instruction.
changed_reading.after: Guidance sets a bearing, while remembrance repeatedly restores that bearing when it leaves active awareness.

baseline_models.mechanism: The lamed directs both benefits toward recipients, and the split WLY inventory of the focus word activates nearness and taking charge. Joined to the inner cores, possession becomes close stewardship of a receptive center rather than a passive intelligence label.

activation_trace.role: Nearness without an intervening gap supplies the recipients' close relation to their inner cores.
Taking charge of an affair turns possession into active stewardship of the faculty that receives guidance.

changed_reading.before: The closing phrase merely names people who possess intellect.
changed_reading.after: It names recipients who keep close charge of their inner core so orientation and reminder can remain operative.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah stages rival claims to guide, a counter-guide who asks to be followed, routes qualified by right direction, and the loss of any guide. Guidance therefore becomes alignment among source, guide, route, and follower, not information whose validity is secured by the word guidance itself.

activation_trace.role: Direction, manner, and purpose provide the focus term with a full orientation that context can test.
A claimed direction and manner make Pharaoh's speech a rival orientation rather than isolated advice.
An extended traversable road gives the asserted guidance a route on which consequences can unfold.
Straightness of path and guidance away from error supply the criterion claimed for that route.
Following behind supplies the practical coupling between the believer's counter-guidance and its hearers.
Gentle indication to the true path supplies the counter-claim whose route must be followed to be tested.
Loss from guidance and intended direction provides the negative control for successful wayfinding.

structural_cues: 40:29 and 40:38 place near-parallel first-person guidance claims on opposing speakers.
40:33 pairs being led astray with the absence of any guide, making source and reception consequential.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies rival guide claims, followership, extended paths, and straightness versus loss; I infer that valid guidance is relational alignment rather than a self-authenticating label. A live alternative is that the parallel wording only heightens rhetorical contrast.

changed_reading.before: Guidance is correct directional content offered to an intelligent audience.
changed_reading.after: Guidance is a contested wayfinding relation whose truth appears in the alignment of guide, route, follower, and destination.

context_deltas.mechanism: Displayed signs do not automatically become remembrance. The restrictive clause in 40:13 joins remembering to repeated return, producing a feedback loop in which signs become active guidance when the reader turns back toward them.

activation_trace.role: Making something present again supplies the focus operation that the return loop activates.
A visible sign supplies the external mark available for renewed recognition.
Recollection after absence names the internal reactivation that the sign alone does not guarantee.
Repeated return to a place or direction supplies the feedback motion that converts a shown sign into remembrance.

structural_cues: 40:13 first presents shown signs and then restricts remembering to one who turns back.
The focus pairing lets return renew both the remembered content and the direction it carries.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a shown sign, recollection, repeated return, and an exclusive construction; I infer a feedback arrow from return through recognition to renewed orientation. Alternatively, turning back may mark an ethical class without describing a cognitive operation.

changed_reading.before: Remembrance is stored knowledge retrieved by a capable mind.
changed_reading.after: Remembrance is generated through recurrent reorientation toward signs, so memory itself is a return practice.

context_deltas.mechanism: The packet frames a delivery chain: a written book is brought down, guidance is given, and the book passes as inherited knowledge. The focus pair then names what that carrier does across handoffs: it orients and repeatedly makes prior truth present.

activation_trace.role: Path indication names the inherited carrier's orienting function.
Making something present again names the carrier's reactivating function across time.
Causing something to descend and reach its recipient supplies the first delivery movement.
Ordered letters and the written object supply a durable medium rather than free-floating instruction.
Giving supplies the deliberate handoff of guidance to Moses.
The explicitly given path indication ties the delivery chain directly to the focus term.
The inheritance of knowledge or a book supplies intergenerational transfer without a new originating act.
The written object is the durable item transferred to the later community.

structural_cues: 40:53 immediately precedes the focus and coordinates giving guidance with making the descendants inherit the book.
40:2 opens the surah by naming the book as something sent down.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies descent, writing, giving, guidance, and inheritance; I infer that 40:54 names the recurring functions of the transmitted medium. The live alternative concerns scope: the pair may characterize the book specifically, the given guidance more broadly, or the whole coordinated gift.

changed_reading.before: Guidance and remembrance are abstract benefits independently available to reflective people.
changed_reading.after: They are the orienting and reactivating work of a delivered, written inheritance carried across generations.

context_deltas.mechanism: The whole-surah pattern turns possession of cores into a practiced sequence: direct perception toward surviving traces, carry them through to outcomes, distinguish states that are not equal, and bind the result so it restrains ignorance. Remembrance is the update that keeps this comparison active.

activation_trace.role: Taking charge supplies an active recipient posture for the evidence-processing sequence.
Directing sight or insight toward something supplies deliberate observation rather than passive exposure.
A remaining mark that indicates what was supplies evidence from an absent past.
The end or outcome supplies the consequence to which observed traces must be carried.
Equality and comparison supply the explicit test that refuses to flatten unlike perceptual and moral states.
Inner sight supplies the discriminating faculty needed to register the non-equivalence.
The closing reminder makes the result of the comparison present and available for action.
Reason that restrains ignorance supplies the binding step that turns a perceived sequence into governed judgment.

structural_cues: 40:21 and 40:82 repeat the travel, look, outcome sequence around surviving earthly traces.
40:58 pairs blind with seeing and faithful good work with wrongdoing, denies equivalence, and closes with little remembrance.
40:67 presents a developmental sequence and closes with the prospect of reasoning.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies observation, traces, outcomes, explicit comparison, inner sight, reminder, and restraining reason; I infer that these are operations performed by the focus audience's cores. Alternatively, the passages may offer separate warnings without defining the audience label.

changed_reading.before: Possessors of cores are an honorific class already equipped to understand.
changed_reading.after: They are people who repeatedly inspect traces, distinguish unequal states, bind evidence to outcomes, and let remembrance govern judgment.

context_deltas.mechanism: Remembrance has a window of efficacy. The warning in 40:44 is remembered alongside entrusting the affair and is followed by protection, whereas seeing the final force in 40:85 no longer yields benefit. The focus reminder therefore intervenes before compelled recognition closes the space for response.

activation_trace.role: A reminder that makes content present supplies the focus intervention whose timing becomes decisive.
Future re-presentation of the warning supplies an anticipated moment of recognition.
Returning an affair to another in reliance supplies the speaker's enacted response before the outcome arrives.
Repelling harm by protection supplies the favorable consequence adjacent to that enacted response.
Direct sight supplies compelled recognition at the terminal stage.
The explicit absence of benefit marks the closure of the response window after terminal sight.

structural_cues: 40:44-45 sequences remembered speech, entrusting, and protection.
40:84-85 sequences sight of force, avowed belief, and the declaration that such belief no longer benefits.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the two sequences; I infer a temporal contrast between actionable remembrance and compelled late sight, while the causal arrow from entrusting to protection is reader-supplied. Alternatively, 40:44 may predict the opponents' later regret rather than timely uptake by the protected speaker.

changed_reading.before: Remembrance is timeless true content, useful whenever it is finally recognized.
changed_reading.after: Remembrance is a timely activation that must revise conduct before direct outcome-sight makes recognition inert.

context_deltas.mechanism: The packet supplies two failures of inner revision: pride accompanies a stamped heart and occupies the breasts, while knowledge held as a possession becomes an occasion for arrogant exultation and is overtaken by consequence. A possessor of cores is therefore not simply informed but internally accessible to corrective guidance and reminder.

activation_trace.role: Impressing a seal supplies a mechanism that closes the receiving surface against further correction.
The pure part or core of a thing creates a direct branch-image bridge from the sealed heart to the focus cores.
The interior source from which acts issue supplies the location in which the obstructing disposition operates.
Magnifying something in the chest supplies pride's inflationary blockage of revision.
Knowledge disclosed to its holder supplies genuine cognition that can nevertheless be mishandled.
Arrogant exultation turns possessed knowledge into a self-sealing source of satisfaction.
Descending harm that encloses its target supplies the consequence of knowledge that refused corrective uptake.

structural_cues: 40:35 joins disputation, pride, sealing, and the heart.
40:56 locates an unattainable pride inside the breasts.
40:83 contrasts possession of knowledge with the hostile outcome surrounding those pleased by it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sealing, a heart branch explicitly imaged as a core, pride in breasts, and exultation in possessed knowledge; I infer that the focus audience is defined by revisability, not information volume. Alternatively, these verses condemn particular attitudes without making permeability a technical meaning of cores.

changed_reading.before: Possessors of cores are those with superior knowledge or intellectual capacity.
changed_reading.after: They are those whose interior remains unsealed and revisable, so knowledge can be corrected by orientation and reminder rather than becoming self-satisfaction.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the form-distant AWL target of the split focus root rather than the ordinary possessive construction. It remains anchored in أُولِي and is reinforced by repeated outcome and return structures; render it only as an exploratory resonance of consequence-aware possession, not as a replacement translation.

activation_trace.role: Return to a final end or outcome makes the focus recipients' cores resonate as consequence-bearing faculties.
The end or outcome supplies the object toward which historical inspection carries the reader.
Return to what was supplies the surah's terminal motion back to the final referent.

changed_reading.before: Possessors of cores names people who have intellect.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it also evokes people whose cores carry beginnings through to their return, end, and consequence.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the documentary-right branch of remembrance rather than ordinary recollection. It remains anchored in ذِكْرَىٰ and gains a visible mechanism from the written book and repeated binding judgment; render it as a legal-documentary undertone, never as the sole lexical sense.

activation_trace.role: A deed or document of right supplies an inspectable evidentiary undertone to the focus reminder.
A written record that establishes a binding judgment supplies the documentary carrier for that undertone.
Decisive judgment supplies the adjudicative setting in which an evidentiary record has force.
A binding due right supplies the obligation that the documentary reminder preserves and exposes.

changed_reading.before: Remembrance only reactivates a truth in the mind.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it also behaves like an inherited evidentiary deed that keeps a binding right available for sound judgment.

strongest_changes: Guidance became a contested relation among guide, route, follower, and destination.
Remembrance became a return-driven and time-sensitive update rather than passive recall.
Possessors of cores became practitioners of trace-to-outcome discernment whose interior must remain unsealed and revisable.
The giving and inheritance sequence made guidance and remembrance functions of an intergenerational written carrier.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet repeatedly staged rival guidance, route inspection, delayed recognition, sealed hearts, and knowledge that fails through exultation. Its split mappings also kept consequence-bearing أُولِي and documentary ذِكْرَىٰ live as contained outliers.
remaining_uncertainties: The exact grammatical scope of guidance and remembrance relative to the book and the given guidance in 40:53 remains open.
The rival guidance claims may define a route-testing mechanism or may function only as rhetorical contrast.
The consequence-bearing and documentary outliers may be branch resonance without contributing to the intended lexical sense.
